title: Buy a Home in Boone NC: The App State Parent Strategy
excerpt: If you have a student at Appalachian State, you may be paying rent every semester with nothing to show for it at graduation. A local High Country REALTOR breaks down why buying a home in Boone NC might be the smarter move for your family.
